column3: a sunny late-morning waterfront harbor circuit: palm trees, low modern harbor buildings with blue glass, concrete barriers, a marina with small boats on calm turquoise water, clean asphalt with white edge lines
the same waterfront harbor circuit at night: warm sodium street lamps pooling light on the asphalt, glowing harbor windows, reflections on dark water, palm silhouettes, a deep blue night sky
a long open coastal highway-style circuit beside the ocean in bright afternoon sun: guard rails, tall street lamps, palm trees, warehouses, sparkling sea on one side
the same coastal circuit at dusk right after rain: wet reflective asphalt mirroring orange and magenta sunset sky, street lamps just switching on, puddles, dramatic clouds
the same coastal circuit at night in light rain: glistening wet road, headlight and tail-light streaks, lamp reflections, moody teal and amber lighting
a winding mountain road climbing through golden dry hills and oak forest in warm late-afternoon light, rolling ridgelines and haze in the distance
the same winding mountain ridge road at blue hour: deep blue twilight sky, last orange glow on the horizon, headlights cutting through, silhouetted oak trees

a premium modern custom-build garage showroom at night: polished checkered floor, black tool cabinets, a vehicle lift, dramatic red and white accent lighting, the three-wheeler parked center stage under spotlights

a premium modern custom-build garage showroom at night: polished checkered floor, black tool cabinets, dramatic red accent lighting; the hero vehicle is a Can-Am Ryker style three-wheel roadster (two wheels at the front, one at the back, motorcycle-style handlebars, matte black with red accents) parked center stage under spotlights
